name: Trinity Stockpile
text: At any time, you may exhaust this card and purge 1 command token from your strategy pool; destroy all units on a planet that contains a superweapon or is adjacent to your home system. Then, exhaust that planet, if able.

name: Prescient Warriors
text:
If you have the Infantry II technology, flip this card and place it on top of Infantry II.

After this unit is destroyed, roll 1 die. If the result is 6 or greater, place that unit on this card, otherwise destroy up to 1 infantry unit on this planet. At the end of your turn, place each unit that is on this card on a legendary planet you control.
Cost 1(x2), Combat 7

name: Hidden Vaults
text: When you explore a planet, you may produce 1 infantry on that planet. At any time, you may exhaust this card to destroy any number of your units on the game board.

name: Duranium Outfitting
text: At the start of ground combat, choose 1 of your plastic-piece infantry participating in that combat; that plastic-piece unit gains SUSTAIN DAMAGE until the end of that combat.

name: Panoply Animus
text: Your structures gain SUSTAIN DAMAGE and participate in ground combat as if they were ground forces with a combat value of 7

name: Echo Operatives
text: When you would return a promissory note to another player, you may exhaust this card to spend 1 token from your strategy pool instead of returning that promissory note. At any time, you may return 1 promissory note to another player to repair one of your ships in a system adjacent to that player's units.

name: Harmonious Diplomacy
text: When you are negotiating a transaction, secret objectives can be exchanged as part of that transaction.

name: Gravehold
text: At any time, you may exhaust this card to place a neutral structure into coexistence on a planet that contains your units. The active player controls coexisting neutral structures as their own. Neutral space docks have PRODUCTION 3.

name: Shameix's Bane
text:
If you have more Dishonor than Honor, flip this card. Players with more victory points than you must give you 1 promissory note to activate a system that contains your units, and cannot use abilities to cancel your action cards.

If you have more Honor than Dishonor, flip this card. Players with fewer victory points than you must give you 1 promissory note to activate a system that contains your units, and cannot use abilities to cancel your action cards.
